body-scan.label: Body scan
body-scan.definition: Attention is moved through the body part by part, noticing sensation and releasing tension.

visualization.label: Visualization
visualization.definition: Guided imagery: the listener is led through an imagined place, scene or journey.

breath-led.label: Breath-led
breath-led.definition: The breath is the main anchor or technique: breath awareness, counting, or a breathing pattern.

manifestation.label: Manifestation
manifestation.definition: The listener imagines a desired future or self as already real, sets intentions, rehearses the feeling of having it.

affirmation-loop.label: Affirmation loop
affirmation-loop.definition: Repeated affirmations (usually 'I am...') are the main content, often with space to repeat them.

story.label: Story
story.definition: A narrative is told to the listener (a tale, parable or story they follow) rather than direct instructions.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.definition: Questions and prompts lead the listener to reflect on their life, emotions, values, choices or gratitude.

sleep.label: Sleep
sleep.definition: Built to take the listener into sleep: slows down, lengthens silences, fades out without a wake-up.

loving-kindness.label: Loving-kindness
loving-kindness.definition: Metta / compassion practice: wishing wellbeing to self, loved ones, strangers, difficult people and all beings.

anxiety-relief.label: Anxiety relief
anxiety-relief.definition: Aimed at calming anxiety, stress or panic: grounding, reassurance, settling the nervous system.

movement-meditation.label: Movement meditation
movement-meditation.definition: Guidance given while moving: walking meditation, mindful movement, gentle yoga or stretching.

open-awareness.label: Open awareness
open-awareness.definition: Resting as awareness itself: choiceless awareness, noticing whatever arises, non-dual pointers to what is aware.
